title: A Telegram chat opened after an image-heavy channel fetches its picture on screen before the channel's waiting thumbnails, and shows it

not_applicable.macos: The check reads screen pixels and types into the window. The macOS lab's helper reads window text only, and teaching it to save a picture rebuilds the ad hoc signed helper, which drops its Screen Recording grant. The download order is chatd's and the same on every desktop.
not_applicable.android: The lab's phone demo build bypasses chatd and cannot run the scripted Telegram wire.
not_applicable.ios: The lab's phone demo build bypasses chatd and cannot run the scripted Telegram wire.
